title: Custom Iterator
concept: Build your own iterator from scratch by implementing the Iterator interface — creating custom data streams and lazy generators.
why: Not all data comes from collections. Custom iterators can generate sequences, read files, or produce infinite streams — all through the same interface.
tips: Custom iterators are STATE MACHINES — each next() call advances the state
Return None when the sequence is exhausted — don't panic or loop forever
Iterators are lazy — values are computed on demand, not stored in memory
Implement size_hint when possible — it helps consumers pre-allocate
common_mistakes: Infinite iterators without a way to stop — always provide take(n) or a max limit
Mutable state bugs — next() should be deterministic and idempotent between calls
Expensive next() — it should be fast since it's called in tight loops
